title: Model: classes, interfaces, enums, annotations, and modifiers
objective: Build immutable Java type descriptions with binary/source names, kind, ownership, flags, and origin.
acceptance_criteria: Top-level type kinds and JVM access flags map without losing unsupported bits.
Binary names remain canonical while readable names are derived.
Malformed and unsupported class versions remain explicit diagnostics.
non_goals: Do not weaken protected contracts, workflow configuration, or unrelated capabilities.
Do not load or execute target classes, builds, plugins, annotation processors, or code.
Do not copy implementation code from the upstream ArchUnit project.
Do not add dependencies or change Maven configuration.
